items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: the manger where Jesus Christ was born

ctx.x: His father was Arabic. And his mother was from Bethlehem. So she was Lebanese, and she was born -- she told me when I was down there -- her house was right across from the manger where Jesus Christ was born, and of course they have a place where they have a business called the Haitian and American Development Corporation, and they import all of the dry goods into that country, and El-Sahee was into construction. He -- through their corporation they could order anything from the United States. They had permanent…
